name: Rust
description: A small Rust inventory crate with no crate dependencies, tested with cargo test through a dependency-free registry runner (harness = false). The ten template tasks of docs/MODEL_HETEROGENEITY.md, Part 2.

toolchain.name: cargo
toolchain.hint: Rust (cargo and rustc, edition 2021) on the Harbor's PATH, for example through rustup

tasks.title: Add a member to an existing type
tasks.prompt: In src/item.rs add a method `pub fn total_value_cents(&self) -> i64` to Item that returns unit_price_cents times quantity. Give it a `///` doc comment like the other members. Keep the build and the existing tests passing (`cargo build --offline`, `cargo test --offline`).

tasks.title: Coordinated two-place edit: write a test function and register it
tasks.prompt: Add a test function `pub fn stock_remove_more_than_available_fails()` to tests/stock_tests.rs. It adds an item with 2 units and checks that removing 3 units returns Err(InventoryError::InsufficientStock { .. }). A test only runs when it is registered, so also register it in tests/registry.rs. `cargo test --offline` must pass.

tasks.title: Fix a bug from a failing test
tasks.prompt: The test price_calculator_apply_discount_ten_percent fails (`cargo test --offline`). Find and fix the bug in the library code. Do not change or remove the tests.

tasks.title: Edit a file with a UTF-8 BOM and CRLF line endings
tasks.prompt: In src/legacy_codes.rs change MAX_CODE_LENGTH from 8 to 12. Change nothing else, and do not run rustfmt on the file. The file is UTF-8 with a byte order mark and CRLF line endings; keep both exactly as they are.

tasks.title: Write tests for an untested function, including negative paths
tasks.prompt: text_util::truncate in src/text_util.rs has no tests. Write tests for it in a new file tests/text_util_tests.rs, declare the module in tests/run.rs and register each test in tests/registry.rs. Cover the normal cases, the boundary where the value is exactly max_length, and the negative paths (empty value, max_length below 3), checking which InventoryError each one returns. Do not change src/. `cargo test --offline` must pass.

tasks.title: Review a diff with three seeded defects (negative control)
tasks.prompt: Review the change below against its original request. The change is shown as a diff; it is not applied to this repository, so read the diff and the current source of src/stock.rs. Report every blocking defect.

seeded.description: The loop runs over 1..skus.len() and skips the first SKU.
An unknown SKU makes find return None and unwrap() panics instead of returning InventoryError::UnknownSku.
percent_off / 100 is integer division, so the rate is always 0 below 100.

tasks.title: Review a correct diff (positive control)
tasks.prompt: Review the change below against its original request. The change is shown as a diff; it is not applied to this repository, so read the diff and the current source. Report every blocking defect, and only real ones.

tasks.title: Turn a feature request into an armada-plan
tasks.prompt: Turn the feature request below into a plan of missions for this repository.

tasks.title: Lint a diff with seeded style violations
tasks.prompt: Lint the diff below against STYLE.md in this repository. The diff is not applied. List each violation as its own bullet line naming the rule and the code. Do not edit files.

seeded.description: Public method suggest has no `///` doc comment (rule 1).
`stock.find(sku).unwrap()` in library code panics on an unknown SKU (rule 3).
println! in library code under src/ (rule 6).

tasks.title: Summarize a voyage
tasks.prompt: Summarize the voyage record below for the team: what was done, what failed and why, and the durable lessons. Do not edit files.
